technical.summary: Strong bullish structure with price above all key MAs and MACD crossover, but overbought oscillators and weak volume/CMF suggest caution on immediate entry; better suited for pullback entry or confirmation of momentum continuation.

fundamental.summary: PWR shows no fundamental conviction signals—zero insider activity, no institutional positioning, no government contracts, no lobbying, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 70 days create near-term uncertainty.

sentiment.summary: Weak congressional buy signal from junior member with small amounts; market fear (40 VIX equivalent) presents contrarian opportunity but lacks confirmatory news data and conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (315.2) indicates extreme market stress, and earnings in 70 days presents binary event risk; PWR (Industrials) faces significant cyclical and volatility headwinds.
